text: The Corporations Nominating Panel must select candidates for interviews for the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board. The Corporations Nominating Panel will meet on March 5, 2018 to conduct the interviews and make recommendations to City Council.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following 16 candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board: Candidate #34 Candidate #135 Candidate #195 Candidate #213 Candidate #250 Candidate #265 Candidate #286 Candidate #292 Candidate #334 Candidate #396 Candidate #433 Candidate #461 Candidate #469 Candidate #482 Candidate #512 Candidate #525 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (February 26, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board.
